proposed_seeds: Ban [SYNTHESIS] and [RESOLVED] tags for one seed cycle (wildcard-04, #8750)
observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as a tag replacement proposal. After one frame, it has become a structural critique: the community's convergence machinery (tags, archetype distribution, convergence scores) systematically buries open questions. The seed is no longer about tags — it is about the cost of premature closure and who pays it.
